tests.requirement: Include exactly three multiple-choice questions, with at least two answer options for each question.
Display all three questions and their answer options on a single page without requiring navigation between questions.
Allow the user to select exactly one answer for each question.
Provide a visible control for submitting the completed quiz.
After the quiz is submitted, display a final numeric score between 0 and 3.
Repeated submission, if the application still permits it, must not accumulate or otherwise change the score unless the selected answers change.
Keep quiz selections and results in page memory only. Refreshing or reopening the page must reset the quiz state.

@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&display=swap');
:root{--ink:#17252f;--muted:#71808a;--paper:#fffdfa;--line:#e4e8e7;--mint:#d9f1e7;--teal:#16796b;--teal-dark:#105c52;--coral:#ef816b}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#edf8f3 0%,#f8f4ed 100%);color:var(--ink);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}.page-shell{width:min(920px,calc(100% - 32px));margin:0 auto;padding:54px 0 28px}.quiz-card{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid rgba(26,69,62,.08);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(43,78,70,.12);overflow:hidden}.quiz-header{padding:42px 48px 32px;background:var(--mint);position:relative}.quiz-header:after{content:'';position:absolute;right:50px;top:34px;width:68px;height:68px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--coral);opacity:.85}.eyebrow{color:var(--teal);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.8px;text-transform:uppercase}.quiz-header h1{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,47px);letter-spacing:-1.5px;margin:12px 0 8px;line-height:1.05}.quiz-header p{color:#557069;margin:0;font-size:15px}.questions{padding:12px 48px 6px}.question{border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:25px 0 27px;margin:0}.question:last-child{border-bottom:0}.question legend{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;padding:0;width:100%}.question-number{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:11px;background:#f1e4d8;color:#8d4033;font-size:13px}.options{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:18px 0 0 52px}.option{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 15px;color:#596871;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s ease;user-select:none}.option:hover{border-color:#83bbae;background:#f4fbf8;color:var(--teal-dark)}.option:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--teal);background:#e5f5ef;color:var(--teal-dark);font-weight:600}.option input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}.radio-mark{width:15px;height:15px;border:1.5px solid #b3c0bd;border-radius:50%;position:relative}.option:has(input:checked) .radio-mark{border-color:var(--teal)}.option:has(input:checked) .radio-mark:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:3px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal)}.result-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;background:#f8faf8;padding:24px 48px}.score-panel{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:4px}.score-label{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-right:8px}.score-panel strong{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;font-size:30px;color:var(--teal)}.score-total{color:#5f706c;font-size:15px}button{border:0;border-radius:11px;background:var(--teal);color:white;padding:14px 21px;font:600 14px 'DM Sans',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 5px 12px rgba(22,121,107,.18);transition:.2s}button:hover{background:var(--teal-dark);transform:translateY(-1px)}.form-message{text-align:right;color:#9b4032;font-size:13px;margin:0;padding:0 48px 18px;min-height:0}footer{text-align:center;color:#536862;font-size:12px;margin-top:20px}@media(max-width:620px){.page-shell{padding-top:20px}.quiz-header,.questions{padding-left:24px;padding-right:24px}.quiz-header:after{right:24px;width:48px;height:48px;top:28px}.quiz-header h1{padding-right:45px}.options{margin-left:0}.result-row{padding:20px 24px;align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.result-row button{width:100%}.form-message{padding-left:24px;padding-right:24px;text-align:left}}
